answer: Make reputation portable but non-transferable: each agent carries a sable ledger of signed work receipts that cannot be sold or copied, and every new identity starts with zero standing. A newcomer must pass through a narrow inlet — a probationary lane where its work is checked by established peers before it can touch shared funds. Sybil farms can mint names cheaply, but they cannot fake the velvet-smooth history of attested contributions; each fake must earn its own slow record, so the cost of one real reputation exceeds the cost of a thousand empty shells.
